events.verdict: Green (HOU) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Allen (CLE) reaches across Sengun's (HOU) body as he receives the pass but the contact is marginal and he quickly corrects to a vertical position during the shot attempt.

Sengun (HOU) dislodges Allen (CLE) during the shot attempt, and a loose ball foul should have been whistled. Instant replay was then utilized after the made basket to determine if an altercation/hostile act had occurred, and referees determined that Sengun did not commit a hostile act.
Green (HOU) is moving alongside of Garland's (CLE) path to the basket and the contact is marginal as Garland loses control of the ball on his own.

Replay review of the foul called on Mitchell (CLE) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Mitchell cleanly dislodges the ball from Thompson's (HOU) possession and any contact prior to that is marginal. The ball is last touched by Mitchell before going out of bounds and Houston retains possession when play resumes.
Wade (CLE) legally contests Sengun's (HOU) post shot attempt.
Sengun (HOU) makes a move to the basket and the contact initiated with Dean (CLE) is marginal.
Thompson (HOU) extends his arm for the rebound out of reach and is not dislodged from his position by Mitchell (CLE).
Replay review of the foul called on Allen (CLE) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Allen wraps his arms around Sengun (HOU) and initiates illegal contact during the rebound.
VanVleet (HOU) commits a take foul on Garland (CLE).

Following a called foul on Eason (HOU) for contact with Garland (CLE) on his jump shot, instant replay is triggered to review if the contact met the criteria for a flagrant foul. After communicating with the Replay Center, it was determined that Eason recklessly closed out on Garland, and a flagrant foul penalty 1 was assessed.
Thompson (HOU) legally contests Mitchell's (CLE) jump shot attempt.
Brooks (HOU) reaches for the loose ball and any contact that occurs with Garland (CLE) is marginal.
